keyDomains.rotation: Root SPKI changes invoke owner-confirmed source-continuity protection; signed note alone does not inherit old data

keyDomains.algorithm: ECDSA P256 SHA256, all level>=5 identities/roles/ceilings precompiled
keyDomains.custody: holders keep private material; additions only signed APK update
keyDomains.rotation: new public key is new high identity requiring compiled policy update

keyDomains.algorithm: ECDSA P256 SHA256, signed bounded delegation certificate below H5
keyDomains.custody: may intentionally be shared/embedded across helper programs by owner bearer model
keyDomains.rotation: issuer-signed lower-scope/level certificate; no caller-package/signature allowlist, no source-extractability downgrade

keyDomains.algorithm: Android Keystore EC P256, per v2 installation, target possession challenge
keyDomains.custody: nonexportable platform key; StrongBox optional, not availability gate
keyDomains.rotation: new install/key needs explicit owner enrollment receipt and new compiled device key; serial/model/UID/APK certificate never substitute

keyDomains.algorithm: Android Keystore AES256 GCM, epoch-owned wrapping keys
keyDomains.custody: key alias manifest per v2 epoch/purpose; no arbitrary alias enumeration/deletion
keyDomains.rotation: wrap account/purpose DEKs; correct normal package same install must still unwrap old epoch before final destruction

keyDomains.algorithm: random AES256 DEK per account/purpose, wrapped under DATA_WRAP; standard platform AEAD
keyDomains.custody: bounded plaintext key lifetime; no repeated lockscreen prompts for routine mail/music; authenticated encryption framing still must be specified/tested
keyDomains.rotation: new objects use new version; old retained until references safely migrated/recovered; no promises after irreversible key destruction

retained: old APK release tags/assets and signing maintenance
legacyLine.privateCustody: UNVERIFIED; public SPKI archive is not private backup proof
legacyLine.materialHandoff: at P2 signing/custody stage verify actual possession/restore procedure without printing keys or passwords; do not block engineering design on a questionnaire now

backupPlan.newOfflinePrivateKeys: two independent encrypted offline copies with owner-held passphrase/recovery inventory; verify restore using signatures against public fingerprint, never expose private bytes
backupPlan.state: PLANNED, not created or backed up
backupPlan.applicationDataBackup: exclude old private data epochs/lease tokens/keystore-dependent vaults from automatic cross-device OS backup unless explicit later recovery design; logical deletion not physical flash/backup overwrite guarantee

enrollmentFlow: start trusted v2 source under NEW formal package and signing identity; no v1 UID/signature migration
create DEVICE_INSTALL key only in explicitly authorized enrollment stage; return limited public challenge
owner locally grants exact device/administrator/target public-key enrollment, platform owner check with true-no-lock handling
prove target installation private-key possession over fresh nonce and proposal digest; independently match displayed public fingerprint
highest may prepare only own list proposal; Root may aggregate all highest/root lists, no unowned raw device enumeration
release authority compiles accepted key/owner/consent-receipt digest; no runtime new device key or high identity admission
same v2 package/signer update preserves this installation Keystore key; whitelist exemption activates only with possession proof and enabled compiled entry
bootstrapCircularity: initial enrollment build must share final v2 appId/formal signer if that key is to survive; separate test app or old v1 cannot supply transferable Android Keystore possession. Before compiled exemption, normal highest-risk requires real owner grant.
deviceInformationPrivacy: compile public keys/owner mapping/minimal receipt digests only, no serial/model/account/raw screenshots; mutable detailed owner receipts remain private and scoped
freshInstall: no historic trust baseline on genuinely empty install; marker missing with existing data locks recovery, never reseeds or erases
knownLimits: compromised APK release signer plus arbitrary malicious same-signer code can remove self-check
hardware attestation optional; do not claim every Android11 device key provably unclonable
an intentionally shared administrator key means shared identity; key possession/source neutrality does not remove nonce/action/target/scope validation
